parsed.explanation: There is no trans-specific criminalisation or documented universal restriction on visitors, and court recognition and visible community organisations are positive signals. However, a 2024 provincial-city report describes discrimination against visibly trans people in public spaces and government institutions, as well as frequent physical and sexual harassment. Those conditions can affect visitors, and effective remedies are not documented. Political hostility is an additional concern, though much of the recent rhetoric described is not trans-specific. The report does not establish a nationwide prevalence rate; conditions may vary. Domestic document-change barriers do not by themselves restrict a visitor using a foreign passport.
